name: yila
description: Search, read and verify papers, format references, and draw editable scientific figures with Yila, with the figure canvas open beside the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Your research workbench and figure canvas, inside your agent.
interface.longDescription: Deep literature search across English and Chinese sources, full-text reading with page citations, reference verification, references in 2,800+ styles including GB/T 7714, and publication-ready figures you can keep editing on the Yila canvas. Uses your Yila account and credits; no API key.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Yila, call yila_get_orientation, and introduce what Yila can do in my language.
